query:
SELECT DISTINCT
            u.id          AS "user_id!",
            u.username    AS "username!",
            u.real_name,
            u.avatar_url,
            u.role        AS "role!: _"
        FROM users u
        WHERE u.is_active = TRUE
          AND (
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM course_enrollments e
                WHERE e.user_id = u.id AND e.course_id = $1
            )
            OR
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM courses c
                WHERE c.id = $1 AND c.teacher_id = u.id
            )
          )
        ORDER BY username ASC
